name: even-keel
description: Plugins for sessions run by Even Keel: the tracker's MCP server and skills for working tasks through it, and context checkpoints

plugins.name: huly
plugins.description: Huly for Even Keel sessions: the huly MCP server and skills to read the task, record decisions, file blockers and questions, split a task into subtasks, close the task by merging, and put a repository on Huly

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub Issues for Even Keel sessions: GitHub's MCP server and a skill to read the issue, record decisions, file blockers and questions, and close the issue by merging

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Linear for Even Keel sessions: Linear's MCP server and a skill to read the issue, record decisions, file blockers and questions, and close the issue by merging

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: GitLab Issues for Even Keel sessions: a PAT-capable MCP server and a skill to read the issue, record decisions, file blockers and questions, and close the issue by merging

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Jira Cloud for Even Keel sessions: the official Atlassian MCP server signed in with an API token and a skill to read the issue, record decisions, file blockers and questions, and close the issue by merging

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: Context checkpoints: once the context grows past a threshold, the session writes a handoff note and ends its turn with CHECKPOINT: <path>, and Even Keel continues the task in a fresh session; a chain session's merge waits for the project's check when no CI judges main

plugins.name: tally
plugins.description: Session audit: a skill that reads Even Keel's stats (Tally), compares a project's sessions before and after a change — a rule edit, a model, a checkpoint threshold — reviews handoffs and compactions, and proposes what to change
